question: It might be too quick to ask, but why have you been using the sound effects [Beben] and [Ben] in Wano Country so far?
answer: Yes you're right. Up until now, it was always [Don] or [Dodon]. I have been using [Ben!] because its the sound that an instrument called a biwa (Japanese lute) makes. However, I've been drawing a shamisen being played instead. So when we get to this scene in the anime, I'm hoping they can put on a good production with the sound mixing team. I'm counting on you, Toei Animation!!
name: Bebebe-n
